segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Hello, this is Land Transport Information at Toronto Airport. How may I help you?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, good morning. Urn, I'm flying to Toronto Airport next week, and I need to get to a town called urn, Milton. Could you tell me how I can get there?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Milton, did you say? Let me see. I think that's about 150 miles south- west of here. In fact it's 147 miles to be exact, so it'll take you at least -say, three to four hours by road.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Wow! Is it as far as that?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, I'm afraid so. But you have a number of options to get you there and you can always rent a car right here at the airport, of course.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. Well, I don't really want to drive myself, so I'd like more information about public transport.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK. In that case the quickest and most comfortable is a cab and of course there are always plenty available. But it'll cost you. You can also take a Greyhound bus or there's an Airport Shuttle Service to Milton.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Hmmm, I think for that kind of distance a cab would be way beyond my budget. But the bus sounds OK. Can you tell me how much that would cost?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Sure. Let's see, that would be $15 one way, or $27.50 return .. . that's on the Greyhound.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, that's quite cheap- great! But whereabouts does it stop in Milton?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: It goes directly from the airport here to the City Centre and it's pretty fast. But you have to bear in mind that there is only one departure a day, so it depends what time your flight gets in.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, of course. Hang on, we're due to get there at 11.30 am.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Hmmm, too bad, the bus leaves at 3.45, so you would have quite a wait- more than 4 hours.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, I see. Well, what about the Shuttle you mentioned?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK. That's the Airport Shuttle that will take you from the airport right to your hotel or private address. It's a door-to-door service and it would suit you much better, because there's one every two hours.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: So how much does that cost?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Let's see. Yeah, that's $35 one way, $65 return, so I guess it's a bit more expensive than the Greyhound.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, that doesn't sound too bad, especially if it'll take me straight to the hotel.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: But you do need to reserve a seat.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK, is it possible to make a booking right now? Through you?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Sure.

segments.speaker: MA N
segments.en: OK, I just have to fill this form out for you. So what date do you want to book this for?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: The 16th of October- oh, no, sorry, that's my departure date. I arrive on the 17th, so book it for then, please.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: So, that's the Toronto Airport Shuttle to Milton. And this is for just one person or . .. ?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, just me, please.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Right. And you said your expected time of arrival was 11.30? So if I book your Shuttle for after 12.00 -let's say, 12.30: that should give you plenty of time to, you know, collect your baggage, maybe grab a coffee?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yeah, that sounds fine, as long as we land on time!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, we'll take your flight details so you don't need to worry too much about that. Now, what about the fare? What sort of ticket do you want? One way or .. .?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, that'll be fine, provided I can book the return trip once I'm there.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: No problem- just allow a couple of days in advance to make sure you get a seat. And what's your name, please?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Janet, Janet Thomson.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Is that Thompson spelt with a 'p'?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: No, it's T-H-0-M-S-0-N.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK. And you'll be coming from the UK? What flight will you be travelling on?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, it's Air Canada flight number AC936, from London Heathrow.

segments.speaker: WMAN
segments.en: Right. Now, do you know where you'll be staying? We need to give the driver an address.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, it's called the Vacation Motel- and I think it's near the town centre. Anyway, the address is 24, Kitchener Street- that's KITCHENER Street.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That's fine. Right, so that's $35 to pay please. Have you got your credit card number there?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, it's a VISA card, and the number is 3303 8450 2045 6837.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK. Well, that seems to be everything. Have a good trip and we'll see you in Toronto next week!

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, bye - oh, thanks for your help!
